title: COMP Children Page
summary: Official Derivative common Children page for Panel COMP child alignment, spacing, margins, justification, fitting, scale, offset, crop, and scrollbar behavior.
guidance: Use Align and Align Order together; Grid Rows, Grid Columns, and Match Network Nodes scale children to fit the Panel Component and use child Align Order for sequencing.
Margins are absolute pixels and do not stretch with the window; they are reflected when the parent draws in a floating window rather than in the node panel viewer.
Fit overrides Justify Horizontal and Justify Vertical, so avoid planning both as independent controls.
Offset can be overwritten by Align and Justify settings above it.
Automatic horizontal and vertical scrollbars appear only when child width or height exceeds the panel dimensions.
